cues.text: Only when you stretch out on the bedclothes to rest a little do
you notice that your journey has made you much more tired than you thought.
In the meantime it has become deep night, it is pouring with rain outside -
and you are very glad to have a roof over your head in this dreadful weather.
You snuggle deep into the warm, cosy blanket and think about your stay in this strange,
foreign world, about the contract you have made with Mylgor, and what your parents...
par...
pa...
-Zzz...
-Zzz...
With your thumb in your mouth, you fall into the deep, dreamless sleep of exhaustion...
Suddenly, though, your sweet slumber is
interrupted by an ugly scraping noise from next door -
a noise like stone scraping on stone!
You get up and want to open the door to the fireplace room - but it is locked!
Frustrated, you lie down again to listen to the mattress for at least a few more hours...
The next afternoon, Mylgor wakes you up and tells you to freshen up
quickly and then come to the fireplace room, where he wants to give you his orders -
but strangely enough, he doesn't say a word about the incident in the night: you decide,
to be on the safe side, not to mention it either, and get up halfway rested and relaxed...
